name: Kushmanda Rasayana

sections.introduction: Kushmanda Rasayana is an herbal formulation in the form of a jam. It provides nourishment to the respiratory system, enhances immunity and provides strength. It can also be called Kushmanda rasayana, Kushmanda avaleha, Kushmanda lehyam. The main ingredient of this herbal formulation is Ash gourd. It rejuvenates the body.
sections.ingredients:
Ash gourd (Cucurbita pepo) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Coriander seeds (Coriandrum sativum) 
 Sugar 
 Honey 

 Method of Preparation 
 Chop and skin the Ash gourd and deseed it and boil it in some water and squeeze it to obtain the juice. Slightly sauté the pulp in clarified butter and add sugar in it. Continue heating it till it reaches a semi solid consistency. After this add the remaining ingredients. After the entire is cool to the touch add honey. The entire product is made in a copper vessel.
sections.dosage: 5 to 15 grams can be consumed with milk or lukewarm water before meals twice a day.

fullContent:
Kushmanda Rasayana 
 Reference: Bhaishajya Ratnavali 
 Introduction 
 Kushmanda Rasayana is an herbal formulation in the form of a jam. It provides nourishment to the respiratory system, enhances immunity and provides strength. It can also be called Kushmanda rasayana, Kushmanda avaleha, Kushmanda lehyam. The main ingredient of this herbal formulation is Ash gourd. It rejuvenates the body. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Ash gourd (Cucurbita pepo) 
 Long pepper (Piper longum) 
 Ginger (Zingiber officinalis) 
 Cumin (Cuminum cyminum) 
 Cinnamon (Cinnamomum verum) 
 Patra (Cinnamomum tamala) 
 Cardamom (Elettaria cardamomum) 
 Black pepper (Piper nigrum) 
 Coriander seeds (Coriandrum sativum) 
 Sugar 
 Honey 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 Chop and skin the Ash gourd and deseed it and boil it in some water and squeeze it to obtain the juice. Slightly sauté the pulp in clarified butter and add sugar in it. Continue heating it till it reaches a semi solid consistency. After this add the remaining ingredients. After the entire is cool to the touch add honey. The entire product is made in a copper vessel. 
 Dosage 
 5 to 15 grams can be consumed with milk or lukewarm water before meals twice a day. 
 Indications 
 
 Bleeding disorders 
 Emaciation 
 Respiratory disorders 
 Provides strength 
 Rejuvenates 
 Improves digestion 
 Strengthens liver 
 
 Contraindications 
 There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
